description:
Got sharp eyes for a busy picture?

Sometimes the answer jumps out. Sometimes you scan every corner and wonder how you missed it.

Caught You Looking is a casual picture-puzzle game where each stage shows one image and asks you to find one exact spot. Read the prompt, check the scene, and select the area that matches.

How to play:
・Read the prompt
・Look over the whole image
・Select the spot that fits
・Move on to the next quick challenge

Each round is short and easy to jump into, but spotting the right place feels satisfying every time.

Play a quick stage whenever you want a light visual challenge.

Button and touch controls are supported.
